answer: Edge case first: a parent who recruits three keys and then goes dark leaves three children with quota but no sponsor, so the tree needs a rule that orphans keep their seats and lose their weight until a new sponsor signs. Beyond that, quota per parent is three, payout converts to a stream vesting over 100 epochs, and a basalt bond backs each key. A 1,000-key farm needs 334 live parents, a plume of parked children with no sponsor earns 0, and the pulse of quota checks runs every epoch.
